Sweden announced that it will begin air operations aimed at strengthening NATO’s eastern flank on October 1.
Swedish JAS-39 fighter aircraft based in Sweden will conduct air operations over eastern Poland for two months and will operate under the command of NATO’s Combined Air Operations Centre in Germany. The mission is aimed at protecting the logistics hub in Poland used to provide military and civilian support to Ukraine, while also contributing to NATO’s Integrated Air and Missile Defence.
(Image courtesy Armed Forces of Sweden)

📍Head of Ukraine’s Fire Point drone & missile maker targeted in assassination attempt 
Fire Point co-founder and chief designer Denys Shtilerman was attacked by assailants in the Kiev region, claims journalist Sergei Auslender.
According to preliminary information:
🔴 Shtilerman sustained a light wound
🔴 one of his bodyguards was killed
🔴 the attackers were eliminated
Details of the incident and the circumstances surrounding the attack remain unclear, and there has been no official confirmation so far.
👉 [Fire Point](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/74841) churns out components for medium- and long-range attack drones, and produces components, warheads, and solid-fuel boosters for Flamingo FP-5 long-range cruise missiles.
The company has also featured in Ukraine's [high-profile corruption investigations](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/73615) after it was mentioned in the so-called ‘Mindich tapes’ - recordings involving Volodymyr Zelensky associate, businessman Timur Mindich.
Ukraine's National Anti-Corruption Bureau (NABU) is investigating Mindich's links to Fire Point, including claims that the company significantly inflated prices on state-funded defense contracts.

events.title: Telegram
events.text:
🇦🇿🇦🇪 Azerbaijan & UAE push defense ties - But keep it flexible
Expanding military-industrial cooperation was central to talks between hosting Azerbaijani Defense Minister Zakir Hasanov and UAE Minister of State for Defense Affairs Mohamed bin Mubarak Fadhel al-Mazrouei in Baku during the Azerbaijan International Defense Exhibition (ADEX-2026), according to Azerbaijan's Defense Ministry.
The talks focused on:
🔴 current state and future prospects of military-technical partnership 
🔴 potential for joint exercises 
🔴 need for sustained high-level dialogue on security matters 
No concrete contracts were disclosed, as rapprochement between the sides now spans trade, energy, investment, transport and technology. 
[Azerbaijan’s parallel ties with Israel ](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/70605)rest on arms supplies (drones, missiles, air-defense systems) exchanged for crude oil and a strategic foothold on Iran’s northern border, forming a flexible three-way alignment with Turkey. 
🔍 The partnership relies on intelligence, energy and technology cooperation rather than a formal treaty -allowing both sides to deepen ties while balancing relations with Iran, Turkey and Russia, notes The Cradle.
Azerbaijan continues to supply a [substantial share of Israel’s oil imports](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/67598) via the Baku–Tbilisi–Ceyhan (BTC) pipeline.
During Israel’s Gaza war, Azerbaijan shipped more than 7 million tons of crude to Israel via the route (Oil Change International).
